name: 17track

api_token.description: 17track REST API access key (official API mode). Set EITHER this OR email+password, never both. The REST API is a paid product (free trial available): register at https://features.17track.net/en/api, then copy your key from the API account at https://api.17track.net under Settings -> Security -> Access Key.

email.description: Email address of your 17track.net account (unofficial mode). Set EITHER email+password OR api_token, never both.

password.description: Password of your 17track.net account. Only used together with email; leave unset when using api_token.

instructions:
Choose ONE authentication mode and set only those values:

1. Official REST API (recommended if you have an API account): set api_token to your access key. This API is now a paid product, but a free trial is available. Register at https://features.17track.net/en/api, then get your key from the API account at https://api.17track.net (Settings -> Security -> Access Key).

2. Unofficial account login (no API account needed): set email and password to your regular 17track.net login. This mode uses the unofficial API that the 17track website itself uses, not a documented public API, so it can break without notice.

Do not set both modes. All values are free-form placeholders; store them as plain strings, e.g. api_token: "YOUR_ACCESS_KEY", email: "you@example.com", password: "your-password".
